text: The schedule of meeting dates for the 2018 Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel is as follows: - April 18, 23, and 27, 2018 (one meeting over three days) - May 28, 2018 Meetings will be held at City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, and begin at 9:30 a.m. There will be a recess at 10:30 a.m. and a recess at 2:30 p.m. Lunch is at 12 noon.
The Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel approved the schedule of meetings for 2018.
